sloka: नूपुर उद्घुष्ट हेला इव खेलम् गच्चति भामिनी ।इदानीम् अपि वैदेही तत् रागा न्यस्त भूषणा ॥२-६०-१९॥
transliteration: nūpura udghuṣṭa helā iva khelam gaccati bhāminī ।idānīm api vaidehī tat rāgā nyasta bhūṣaṇā ॥2-60-19॥

translations.english: Casting off her ornaments, the damsel (Sita) is gracefully walking as if dalliant with her tinkling anklets for her love for him (Rama).
